name: Combat of Clarity
description: An old tradition in which disagreeing Arbiter Twins fight in single combat.

description_citations.text: "Kela and Dar Chensal". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kela defeats Dar in the Combat of Clarity, proclaiming Lotse innocent of the murder.
timeline.quote: Defeated, Dar conceded, and Kela let him up, thus proclaiming that Lotse was innocent of the murder of Elder Ngabo.

citation.text: "Kela and Dar Chensal", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The twins fight the Combat of Clarity, and Kela, seeing everything clearly, defeats Dar.
timeline.quote: Kela leapt into a spinning strike and landed in a crouch on the ground with her knee on Dar's chest and her blade at his throat.

citation.text: "The Chensal Twins" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Oct 2014.

pages_say.description: An old, unused Arbiter Twin tradition of single combat when the twins disagree on a verdict, won by the twin with greater clarity.

citation.text: "The Chensal Twins" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Oct 2014.
